The '''Ord Pedrovia''' was a model of [[podracer]]. The [[Xexto]] [[pilot]] [[Gasgano]] flew a [[Color|green]] one during a [[Boonta Eve Classic]] race that took place during the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. Gasgano's cockpit had a [[camera]] built into the back of it, which connected to a [[Viewscreen|holoscreen]] on the cockpits control panel, which allowed to the Xexto to keep an eye on any competitors who wished to pass him. During the Boonta, Gasgano used this feature to his advantage when dueling the [[human]] pilot [[Anakin Skywalker]], blocking all of the Human's attempts to pass. Skywalker finally overcame Gasgano when he flew over the Ord Pedrovia following a cliff drop.<ref name="TPM" />

During the [[Clone Wars]], an [[Ishi Tib]]<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/orders-episode-guide|text="Orders" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> flew an Ord Pedrovia of his own during a race that was broadcast in [[Cantina|bar]] located on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], called [[79's]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ord Pedrovia first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Certain technical aspects of the podracer were fleshed out in various sources that are now considered to be a part of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, and no longer a part of proper [[canon]].
